title: AI Didn't Save Time, Publishing Does
description: Steven looks back on his attempts to automate content with AI and argues that portable skills and publishing every day matter more than visa strategies. He also asks whether a market correction is coming, pointing to Bitcoin's four-year cycle, the midterm elections and the Fed.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Quick Overview

sentences.zh: 这期周二的节目，是史蒂文睡了一个没打算睡的午觉后录的。
sentences.en: This Tuesday episode was recorded after Steven took a nap he hadn't planned to take.

sentences.zh: 他怪罪于干菠萝带来的“糖分崩溃”。
sentences.en: He blames it on a "sugar crash" from dried pineapple.

sentences.zh: 他回顾了自己多年来用AI把内容自动化的尝试，结论是：AI多半只给他添了更多活儿。
sentences.en: He looks back on his years of attempts to automate content with AI, and concludes that AI has mostly just given him more work.

sentences.zh: 他还解释了为什么技能比签证更重要，劝大家多发布作品，并抛出一个问题：市场是不是该回调了？
sentences.en: He also explains why skills matter more than visas, urges everyone to publish more of their work, and raises a question: is the market due for a correction?

sentences.zh: 干果、午觉，还有跑步和健身房的难题
sentences.en: Dried fruit, a nap, and the running-versus-gym dilemma

sentences.zh: 下午3点05分下课，回家路上，史蒂文买了西瓜和干菠萝，指望糖分能撑过整个晚上，结果事与愿违。
sentences.en: Class ended at 3:05 p.m. On the way home, Steven bought watermelon and dried pineapple, hoping the sugar would keep him going all evening, but things didn't turn out as planned.

sentences.zh: 干果的糖分比新鲜水果高得多，店里还在菠萝上撒了白砂糖，跟巧克力差不多。
sentences.en: Dried fruit has far more sugar than fresh fruit, and the shop had also sprinkled white sugar on the pineapple, making it about the same as chocolate.

sentences.zh: 站了一整天，他躺下就睡过了头，只好在“继续赖床”和“去上晚上7点的中文课”之间做选择。
sentences.en: After standing all day, he lay down and overslept, leaving him to choose between "staying in bed" and "going to the 7 p.m. Chinese class."

sentences.zh: 早上的跑步他也没去，只在跑步机上象征性地跑了15分钟。
sentences.en: He also skipped his morning run, doing only a token 15 minutes on the treadmill.

sentences.zh: 天气渐冷，他估计这个冬天去健身房会比户外跑步更多。
sentences.en: As the weather gets colder, he expects he'll go to the gym more than run outdoors this winter.

sentences.zh: 回头聊聊“长期居留”那一期
sentences.en: Looking back at the "long-term residence" episode

sentences.zh: 史蒂文推荐了周一（9月28日）那期，说它是自己做得比较有用的一期，讲的是在国外长住的“进阶篇”：工作签证、开公司、拿学位、中国的积分制度，以及没跟本地人结婚时还有哪些选择。
sentences.en: Steven recommended the Monday (September 28) episode, saying it was one of the more useful ones he'd made. It covered the "advanced guide" to living abroad long-term: work visas, starting a company, getting a degree, China's points system, and what options remain if you haven't married a local.

sentences.zh: 他打算为Substack重新录一遍。
sentences.en: He plans to re-record it for Substack.

sentences.zh: 他也想过离开中国，但“可不是说走就能走”，而且他心里也有一部分想留下来，看看事情会怎么发展。
sentences.en: He has also thought about leaving China, but "it's not like you can just up and leave," and part of him also wants to stay and see how things develop.

sentences.zh: AI课程与Substack“流水线”的美梦
sentences.en: AI courses and the Substack "assembly line" dream

sentences.zh: 去年这个时候，史蒂文花了大约1400加元，报了YouTuber Tina Huang的AI课程。
sentences.en: Around this time last year, Steven spent about 1,400 Canadian dollars to sign up for YouTuber Tina Huang's AI course.

sentences.zh: 贵不贵？
sentences.en: Was it expensive?

sentences.zh: “很难说不贵。”
sentences.en: "It's hard to say it wasn't."

sentences.zh: 课程没给他带来工作，也没带来新人脉。
sentences.en: The course didn't get him a job, and it didn't bring him any new connections either.

sentences.zh: 这一年AI变化太快，他早就不再追她的内容了。
sentences.en: AI changed so fast this year that he stopped following her content long ago.

sentences.zh: 他当时想取代自己的工作，并把播客文字稿自动变成Substack文章：一段语音备忘录变成30条内容，还没有“嗯”“呃”。
sentences.en: At the time, he wanted to automate away his own job and turn his podcast transcripts into Substack articles automatically: one voice memo would become 30 pieces of content, with no "ums" or "uhs."

sentences.zh: 他曾花钱请人校对文字稿，后来发现对方不过是在给AI写提示词，于是决定自己来。
sentences.en: He once paid someone to proofread his transcripts, but later found out they were just writing prompts for AI, so he decided to do it himself.

sentences.zh: 可Substack的文章读起来东一榔头西一棒槌，因为每期节目的话题跳来跳去。
sentences.en: But the Substack articles read as scattered and disjointed, because the topics in each episode jump all over the place.

sentences.zh: 拆分频道，把播客当日记
sentences.en: Splitting the channels, treating the podcast as a diary

sentences.zh: 史蒂文正在重新整理自己的项目：
sentences.en: Steven is reorganizing his projects:

sentences.zh: 语言博客播客：独立成英语教学和语言学习节目。
sentences.en: Language blog podcast: becoming a standalone English-teaching and language-learning show.

sentences.zh: YouTube频道：转向讲述海外生活的故事型视频博客。
sentences.en: YouTube channel: shifting to story-driven vlogs about life abroad.

sentences.zh: SSAB：基本不变。
sentences.en: SSAB: basically unchanged.

sentences.zh: SSAB始于2021年，最初是记录疫情期间在中国的生活。
sentences.en: SSAB started in 2021, originally documenting life in China during the pandemic.

sentences.zh: 如今它每个工作日晚上更新，有点像一本日记。
sentences.en: Now it's updated every weekday evening, a bit like a diary.

sentences.zh: “我不是在追粉丝，我追的是自己心里的清晰。”
sentences.en: "I'm not chasing followers; what I'm chasing is clarity in my own mind."

sentences.zh: AI自动化的真实面目
sentences.en: The truth about AI automation

sentences.zh: ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude Code，还有Zapier这类零代码工具，史蒂文都试过。
sentences.en: Steven has tried ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude Code, and no-code tools like Zapier.

sentences.zh: 他的难题是时间：搭建自动化会挤占做内容的时间，而作为老师，他自己就是产品。
sentences.en: His problem is time: building automations eats into the time for making content, and as a teacher, he himself is the product.

sentences.zh: 他把自己的水平称为“平民级AI用法”。
sentences.en: He calls his level "everyday-person AI use."

sentences.zh: 除了那几位校对员，他没见过AI真正取代谁的工作，反倒让他更忙了。
sentences.en: Apart from a few proofreaders, he hasn't seen AI truly replace anyone's job; if anything, it has made him busier.

sentences.zh: 学自动化本想挤出10个小时，最后变成一周半的折腾，之后东西一坏还得修。
sentences.en: Learning automation was supposed to free up 10 hours, but it ended up as a week and a half of fiddling, and then whenever something breaks he still has to fix it.

sentences.zh: 他现在的做法大约要三小时：让AI把文字稿整理成节目摘要，再当讲稿重新录给Substack，然后为TikTok再拍一次。
sentences.en: His current process takes about three hours: he has AI turn the transcript into an episode summary, then uses it as a script to re-record for Substack, and then films it again for TikTok.

sentences.zh: “老兄，你是在跟0和1说话，抱歉告诉你这个。”
sentences.en: "Buddy, you're talking to zeros and ones, sorry to break it to you."

sentences.zh: 签证策略，还是积累技能
sentences.en: Visa strategy, or building skills

sentences.zh: 史蒂文四十五岁上下。
sentences.en: Steven is around forty-five.

sentences.zh: 他指出，中国迟早会不再给他发工作签证，大概在60岁，最晚70岁。
sentences.en: He points out that sooner or later China will stop issuing him a work visa, probably at 60, at the latest 70.

sentences.zh: 那为什么要花好几年去读一个终有一天要他离开的体系里的学位？
sentences.en: So why spend several years studying for a degree in a system that will one day require him to leave?

sentences.zh: 他宁可积累走到哪儿都带得走的技能，首先是AI自动化。
sentences.en: He would rather build skills he can take with him wherever he goes, starting with AI automation.

sentences.zh: 这就是他坚持做播客的原因。
sentences.en: That's why he keeps making the podcast.

sentences.zh: 十到十五年后，你是想多教了一千节没人记得的课，还是拥有一千期可以重新发布的节目？
sentences.en: Ten to fifteen years from now, would you rather have taught a thousand more lessons nobody remembers, or own a thousand episodes you can republish?

sentences.zh: 你发布什么，别人就记住你什么
sentences.en: Whatever you publish is what people remember you for.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文喜欢一句话：“你以发布的作品闻名，所以多发布吧。”
sentences.en: Steven likes a saying: "You're known for the work you publish, so publish more."

sentences.zh: Substack、YouTube、Instagram都是免费的。
sentences.en: Substack, YouTube and Instagram are all free.

sentences.zh: 发布作品能为你留下记录，下次求职就不必全靠推荐人。
sentences.en: Publishing your work leaves a record of you, so next time you look for a job you won't have to rely entirely on references.

sentences.zh: 没人需要看你最初的一百期，以后还可以删掉。
sentences.en: Nobody needs to see your first hundred episodes, and you can delete them later anyway.

sentences.zh: “要是你成了那个日复一日坐下来录音的人……一百年后，那该是多惊人的档案啊。”
sentences.en: "If you become the person who sits down to record day after day... a hundred years from now, what an amazing archive that would be."

sentences.zh: 市场：比特币、中期选举与美联储
sentences.en: Markets: Bitcoin, the Midterm Elections and the Federal Reserve

sentences.zh: （以下都不是投资建议，请咨询专业人士。）
sentences.en: (None of the following is investment advice; please consult a professional.)

sentences.zh: 史蒂文一直在听《This Week in Bitcoin》，比特币的四年周期似乎正在走向终点。
sentences.en: Steven has been listening to "This Week in Bitcoin," and Bitcoin's four-year cycle seems to be coming to an end.

sentences.zh: 它2022年在2万美元附近见底，涨到约11万至11.7万美元的峰值，最近跌到6万美元左右，现在回到8.4万美元上下。
sentences.en: It bottomed out around $20,000 in 2022, rose to a peak of about $110,000 to $117,000, recently fell to around $60,000, and is now back at roughly $84,000.

sentences.zh: 他认为2025年底的下跌，是早期持有者趁机套现。
sentences.en: He thinks the drop at the end of 2025 was early holders seizing the chance to cash out.

sentences.zh: 他不信纯技术分析，选股很简单：在银行、公用事业、黄金、能源和医疗的ETF里，各挑前两名。
sentences.en: He doesn't believe in pure technical analysis, and his stock picking is simple: among ETFs for banks, utilities, gold, energy and healthcare, he picks the top two in each.

sentences.zh: 今年是特朗普两个任期的第六年，11月有中期选举。
sentences.en: This year is the sixth year of Trump's two terms, and there are midterm elections in November.

sentences.zh: 如果共和党输了，他预计会出现“跛脚鸭”的头条，投资者转向现金。
sentences.en: If the Republicans lose, he expects "lame duck" headlines, and investors moving into cash.

sentences.zh: 再加上美联储加息、比特币周期，以及乌克兰和伊朗的战事，他认为“完美风暴”并非不可能。
sentences.en: Add to that Fed rate hikes, the Bitcoin cycle, and the wars in Ukraine and Iran, and he thinks a "perfect storm" isn't impossible.

sentences.zh: 他的建议是：别慌，最好别看。
sentences.en: His advice: don't panic, and it's best not to look.

sentences.zh: “市场保持非理性的时间，可能比你撑得住的时间更长。”
sentences.en: "The market can stay irrational longer than you can stay solvent."

sentences.zh: 明天的话题是债券：政府得为债务付出更多利息。
sentences.en: Tomorrow's topic is bonds: the government has to pay more interest on its debt.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's summary

sentences.zh: AI不会替你干活，但日复一日发布你所知道的东西，能积累出经久不衰的成果。
sentences.en: AI won't do the work for you, but publishing what you know day after day can build up lasting results.

sentences.zh: 在市场里也一样，就像午觉一样，时机比你想的更重要。
sentences.en: It's the same in the market: just like with a nap, timing matters more than you think.

vocab.en: the opposite of what one hoped for happens

vocab.py: dōng yī láng tou xī yī bàng chuí

vocab.en: to fuss over, go through hassle
